  <script>
    (function() {
      const sheetBaseId = "1EyOarKss30HjPdbNSAknT3cns80XemVLSlzjsUMF3I4";
      const usMidtermElectionsUrls = {
        A: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetBaseId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=896529618`,
        B: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetBaseId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=364080587`,
        C: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetBaseId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=1391487270`,
        D: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetBaseId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=1124626584`
      };

      const colorsDef = {
        left: "#1e76f7",   
        center: "#ababab", 
        right: "#f93a49"   
      };

      function parseCsvData(csvText) {
        const lines = csvText.trim().split(/\r\n|\n/);
        if (lines.length < 2) return { headers: [], values: [] };
        
        const rawHeaders = lines[0].split(",");
        const rawValues = lines[1].split(",");

        const headers = rawHeaders.map(val => val.replace(/["']/g, "").trim());
        const values = rawValues.map(val => {
          const cleanVal = val.replace(/["']/g, "").trim();
          return Number(cleanVal) || 0;
        });

        return { headers, values };
      }

      function calculateDisplayWidths(items, minWidthOption) {
        let leftSum = 0;
        let rightSum = 0;
        
        items.forEach(item => {
          if (item.role === 'left') leftSum += item.value;
          if (item.role === 'right') rightSum += item.value;
        });
        
        const loserRole = (leftSum > rightSum) ? 'right' : (rightSum > leftSum ? 'left' : 'right');
        let displayValues = items.map(item => item.value);
        
        const minWidths = items.map(item => {
          if (typeof minWidthOption === 'function') {
            return minWidthOption(item.value);
          }
          return minWidthOption; 
        });
        
        items.forEach((item, i) => {
          const currentMin = minWidths[i];
          if (item.value > 0 && item.value < currentMin) {
            const deficit = currentMin - item.value;
            displayValues[i] = currentMin;
            
            let maxLoserVal = -1;
            let maxLoserIdx = -1;
            displayValues.forEach((dVal, j) => {
              if (items[j].role === loserRole && dVal > maxLoserVal) {
                maxLoserVal = dVal;
                maxLoserIdx = j;
              }
            });
            
            if (maxLoserIdx !== -1) {
              displayValues[maxLoserIdx] -= deficit;
              if (displayValues[maxLoserIdx] < minWidths[maxLoserIdx]) {
                displayValues[maxLoserIdx] = minWidths[maxLoserIdx];
              }
            }
          }
        });
        
        return displayValues;
      }

      function renderChartFromItems(chartId, items, minWidthOption) {
        const chartElement = document.getElementById(chartId);
        if (!chartElement) return;

        chartElement.innerHTML = '';

        const totalOriginal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.value, 0);
        if (totalOriginal === 0) return;

        const displayValues = calculateDisplayWidths(items, minWidthOption);
        const totalDisplay = displayValues.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0);

        items.forEach((item, index) => {
          if (item.value === 0) return;

          const percentage = (displayValues[index] / totalDisplay) * 100;
          
          const barElement = document.createElement("div");
          barElement.className = "us-midterm-elections-bar";
          barElement.style.width = percentage + "%";
          barElement.style.backgroundColor = colorsDef[item.role];
          
          let displayText = item.value;
          
          if (item.isHatch) {
            barElement.classList.add("us-midterm-elections-hatch");
            displayText += "（非改選）";
          }
          
          if (item.hasBorder) {
            barElement.classList.add("us-midterm-elections-border-right");
          }
          
          const textSpan = document.createElement("span");
          textSpan.className = "us-midterm-elections-bar-text";
          textSpan.textContent = displayText;
          barElement.appendChild(textSpan);
          
          chartElement.appendChild(barElement);
        });
      }

      let isFetching = false;

      function fetchAndRenderAll() {
        if (isFetching) return;
        isFetching = true;

        Promise.all([
          fetch(usMidtermElectionsUrls.A).then(res => res.text()).catch(e => ""),
          fetch(usMidtermElectionsUrls.B).then(res => res.text()).catch(e => ""),
          fetch(usMidtermElectionsUrls.C).then(res => res.text()).catch(e => ""),
          fetch(usMidtermElectionsUrls.D).then(res => res.text()).catch(e => "")
        ]).then(([csvA, csvB, csvC, csvD]) => {
          const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;

          // Chart A 
          if (csvA) {
            const parsedA = parseCsvData(csvA);
            const itemsA = [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
              const header = parsedA.headers[i] || "";
              const val = parsedA.values[i] || 0;
              let role = "center";
              if (header.indexOf("民主") !== -1) role = "left";
              else if (header.indexOf("共和") !== -1) role = "right";

              const isHatch = (header.indexOf("非改選") !== -1);
              let hasBorder = false;

              if (i === 1 && (parsedA.values[2] || 0) > 0) hasBorder = true;
              if (i === 4 && (parsedA.values[5] || 0) > 0) hasBorder = true;

              itemsA.push({ value: val, role: role, isHatch: isHatch, hasBorder: hasBorder });
            }
            renderChartFromItems("us-midterm-elections-chart-a-sp", itemsA, isMobile ? 3 : 2);
          }

          // Chart B 
          if (csvB) {
            const parsedB = parseCsvData(csvB);
            const itemsB = [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= 2; i++) {
              const header = parsedB.headers[i] || "";
              const val = parsedB.values[i] || 0;
              let role = "center";
              if (header.indexOf("民主") !== -1) role = "left";
              else if (header.indexOf("共和") !== -1) role = "right";

              itemsB.push({ value: val, role: role, isHatch: false, hasBorder: false });
            }
            renderChartFromItems("us-midterm-elections-chart-b-sp", itemsB, isMobile ? 3 : 2);
          }

          // Chart C
          if (csvC) {
            const parsedC = parseCsvData(csvC);
            const itemsC = [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
              const header = parsedC.headers[i] || "";
              const val = parsedC.values[i] || 0;
              let role = "center";
              if (header.indexOf("民主") !== -1) role = "left";
              else if (header.indexOf("共和") !== -1) role = "right";

              itemsC.push({ value: val, role: role, isHatch: false, hasBorder: false });
            }
            const minWidthOptionC = isMobile 
              ? function(val) {
                  if (val > 0 && val < 10) return 15;
                  if (val >= 10 && val < 100) return 30;
                  return 10;
                }
              : 10;
            renderChartFromItems("us-midterm-elections-chart-c-sp", itemsC, minWidthOptionC);
          }

          // Chart D
          if (csvD) {
            const parsedD = parseCsvData(csvD);
            const itemsD = [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
              const header = parsedD.headers[i] || "";
              const val = parsedD.values[i] || 0;
              let role = "center";
              if (header.indexOf("民主") !== -1) role = "left";
              else if (header.indexOf("共和") !== -1) role = "right";

              itemsD.push({ value: val, role: role, isHatch: false, hasBorder: false });
            }
            renderChartFromItems("us-midterm-elections-chart-d-sp", itemsD, isMobile ? 13 : 10);
          }

          isFetching = false;
        }).catch(err => {
          console.error(err);
          isFetching = false;
        });
      }

      // 初回実行
      fetchAndRenderAll();

      let currentWidth = window.innerWidth;
      window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
        const isNowMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;
        const wasMobile = currentWidth <= 768;
        if (isNowMobile !== wasMobile) {
          currentWidth = window.innerWidth;
          fetchAndRenderAll();
        }
      });

      // Ajax上書き対策
      const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
        let needsRender = false;
        mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
          if (mutation.type === 'childList') {
            const chartA = document.getElementById("us-midterm-elections-chart-a-sp");
            if (chartA && chartA.querySelectorAll('.us-midterm-elections-bar').length === 0) {
              needsRender = true;
            }
          }
        });
        if (needsRender) {
          fetchAndRenderAll();
        }
      });
      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

    })();
  </script>

  <script>
    (function() {
      const sheetBaseId = "1EyOarKss30HjPdbNSAknT3cns80XemVLSlzjsUMF3I4";
      const usMidtermElectionsUrls = {
        A: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetBaseId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=896529618`,
        B: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetBaseId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=364080587`,
        C: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetBaseId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=1391487270`,
        D: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetBaseId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=1124626584`
      };

      const colorsDef = {
        left: "#1e76f7",   
        center: "#ababab", 
        right: "#f93a49"   
      };

      function parseCsvData(csvText) {
        const lines = csvText.trim().split(/\r\n|\n/);
        if (lines.length < 2) return { headers: [], values: [] };
        
        const rawHeaders = lines[0].split(",");
        const rawValues = lines[1].split(",");

        const headers = rawHeaders.map(val => val.replace(/["']/g, "").trim());
        const values = rawValues.map(val => {
          const cleanVal = val.replace(/["']/g, "").trim();
          return Number(cleanVal) || 0;
        });

        return { headers, values };
      }

      function calculateDisplayWidths(items, minWidthOption) {
        let leftSum = 0;
        let rightSum = 0;
        
        items.forEach(item => {
          if (item.role === 'left') leftSum += item.value;
          if (item.role === 'right') rightSum += item.value;
        });
        
        const loserRole = (leftSum > rightSum) ? 'right' : (rightSum > leftSum ? 'left' : 'right');
        let displayValues = items.map(item => item.value);
        
        const minWidths = items.map(item => {
          if (typeof minWidthOption === 'function') {
            return minWidthOption(item.value);
          }
          return minWidthOption; 
        });
        
        items.forEach((item, i) => {
          const currentMin = minWidths[i];
          if (item.value > 0 && item.value < currentMin) {
            const deficit = currentMin - item.value;
            displayValues[i] = currentMin;
            
            let maxLoserVal = -1;
            let maxLoserIdx = -1;
            displayValues.forEach((dVal, j) => {
              if (items[j].role === loserRole && dVal > maxLoserVal) {
                maxLoserVal = dVal;
                maxLoserIdx = j;
              }
            });
            
            if (maxLoserIdx !== -1) {
              displayValues[maxLoserIdx] -= deficit;
              if (displayValues[maxLoserIdx] < minWidths[maxLoserIdx]) {
                displayValues[maxLoserIdx] = minWidths[maxLoserIdx];
              }
            }
          }
        });
        
        return displayValues;
      }

      function renderChartFromItems(chartId, items, minWidthOption) {
        const chartElement = document.getElementById(chartId);
        if (!chartElement) return;

        chartElement.innerHTML = '';

        const totalOriginal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.value, 0);
        if (totalOriginal === 0) return;

        const displayValues = calculateDisplayWidths(items, minWidthOption);
        const totalDisplay = displayValues.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0);

        items.forEach((item, index) => {
          if (item.value === 0) return;

          const percentage = (displayValues[index] / totalDisplay) * 100;
          
          const barElement = document.createElement("div");
          barElement.className = "us-midterm-elections-bar";
          barElement.style.width = percentage + "%";
          barElement.style.backgroundColor = colorsDef[item.role];
          
          let displayText = item.value;
          
          if (item.isHatch) {
            barElement.classList.add("us-midterm-elections-hatch");
            displayText += "（非改選）";
          }
          
          if (item.hasBorder) {
            barElement.classList.add("us-midterm-elections-border-right");
          }
          
          const textSpan = document.createElement("span");
          textSpan.className = "us-midterm-elections-bar-text";
          textSpan.textContent = displayText;
          barElement.appendChild(textSpan);
          
          chartElement.appendChild(barElement);
        });
      }

      let isFetching = false;

      function fetchAndRenderAll() {
        if (isFetching) return;
        isFetching = true;

        Promise.all([
          fetch(usMidtermElectionsUrls.A).then(res => res.text()).catch(e => ""),
          fetch(usMidtermElectionsUrls.B).then(res => res.text()).catch(e => ""),
          fetch(usMidtermElectionsUrls.C).then(res => res.text()).catch(e => ""),
          fetch(usMidtermElectionsUrls.D).then(res => res.text()).catch(e => "")
        ]).then(([csvA, csvB, csvC, csvD]) => {
          const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;

          // Chart A 
          if (csvA) {
            const parsedA = parseCsvData(csvA);
            const itemsA = [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
              const header = parsedA.headers[i] || "";
              const val = parsedA.values[i] || 0;
              let role = "center";
              if (header.indexOf("民主") !== -1) role = "left";
              else if (header.indexOf("共和") !== -1) role = "right";

              const isHatch = (header.indexOf("非改選") !== -1);
              let hasBorder = false;

              if (i === 1 && (parsedA.values[2] || 0) > 0) hasBorder = true;
              if (i === 4 && (parsedA.values[5] || 0) > 0) hasBorder = true;

              itemsA.push({ value: val, role: role, isHatch: isHatch, hasBorder: hasBorder });
            }
            renderChartFromItems("us-midterm-elections-chart-a-pc", itemsA, isMobile ? 3 : 2);
          }

          // Chart B 
          if (csvB) {
            const parsedB = parseCsvData(csvB);
            const itemsB = [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= 2; i++) {
              const header = parsedB.headers[i] || "";
              const val = parsedB.values[i] || 0;
              let role = "center";
              if (header.indexOf("民主") !== -1) role = "left";
              else if (header.indexOf("共和") !== -1) role = "right";

              itemsB.push({ value: val, role: role, isHatch: false, hasBorder: false });
            }
            renderChartFromItems("us-midterm-elections-chart-b-pc", itemsB, isMobile ? 3 : 2);
          }

          // Chart C
          if (csvC) {
            const parsedC = parseCsvData(csvC);
            const itemsC = [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
              const header = parsedC.headers[i] || "";
              const val = parsedC.values[i] || 0;
              let role = "center";
              if (header.indexOf("民主") !== -1) role = "left";
              else if (header.indexOf("共和") !== -1) role = "right";

              itemsC.push({ value: val, role: role, isHatch: false, hasBorder: false });
            }
            const minWidthOptionC = isMobile 
              ? function(val) {
                  if (val > 0 && val < 10) return 15;
                  if (val >= 10 && val < 100) return 30;
                  return 10;
                }
              : 10;
            renderChartFromItems("us-midterm-elections-chart-c-pc", itemsC, minWidthOptionC);
          }

          // Chart D
          if (csvD) {
            const parsedD = parseCsvData(csvD);
            const itemsD = [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
              const header = parsedD.headers[i] || "";
              const val = parsedD.values[i] || 0;
              let role = "center";
              if (header.indexOf("民主") !== -1) role = "left";
              else if (header.indexOf("共和") !== -1) role = "right";

              itemsD.push({ value: val, role: role, isHatch: false, hasBorder: false });
            }
            renderChartFromItems("us-midterm-elections-chart-d-pc", itemsD, isMobile ? 13 : 10);
          }

          isFetching = false;
        }).catch(err => {
          console.error(err);
          isFetching = false;
        });
      }

      // 初回実行
      fetchAndRenderAll();

      let currentWidth = window.innerWidth;
      window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
        const isNowMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;
        const wasMobile = currentWidth <= 768;
        if (isNowMobile !== wasMobile) {
          currentWidth = window.innerWidth;
          fetchAndRenderAll();
        }
      });

      // Ajax上書き対策
      const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
        let needsRender = false;
        mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
          if (mutation.type === 'childList') {
            const chartA = document.getElementById("us-midterm-elections-chart-a-pc");
            if (chartA && chartA.querySelectorAll('.us-midterm-elections-bar').length === 0) {
              needsRender = true;
            }
          }
        });
        if (needsRender) {
          fetchAndRenderAll();
        }
      });
      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

    })();
  </script>
